title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still cannot access.

title: Payment Failed - Card Declined
description: Customer attempted to pay using Visa ending 1234 but the payment keeps failing despite sufficient balance.

title: Account Locked - Security Alert
description: Customer's account was locked after multiple failed login attempts.

title: Refund Not Processed
description: Customer requested a refund 10 days ago but the refund has not been reflected in their bank account.

title: Order Not Delivered
description: Customer placed an order two weeks ago but has not received the delivery yet.

title: Password Reset Email Not Received
description: Customer requested a password reset but never received the reset email.

title: App Crashing on Login
description: The mobile app crashes immediately when the customer tries to log in.

title: Duplicate Payment Charged
description: Customer was charged twice for a single transaction.

title: Unable to Update Profile
description: Customer cannot update their phone number or address in the profile settings.

title: Subscription Not Renewing
description: Customer’s subscription did not auto-renew even though payment details are valid.

title: Gift Card Not Working
description: Customer tried to redeem a gift card but it shows invalid code.

title: Delayed Customer Support Response
description: Customer submitted a support ticket 5 days ago but has not received a reply.

title: Incorrect Billing Amount
description: Customer was charged a higher amount than displayed during checkout.

title: Unable to Cancel Order
description: Customer tried to cancel an order but the option was not available on the app.

title: Wrong Item Delivered
description: Customer received a different product instead of what they ordered.
